market_reason: Sharp equity selloff (Dow -1,084, Nasdaq -2.2%, S&P on a sixth straight loss) amid rate-hike fears and AI-bubble worries, plus a string of bank and tech outages, but nothing indicating crisis-grade systemic failure.

summary: US equities sold off hard despite Anthropic's record IPO, with J.P. Morgan now calling for Fed hikes at the next three meetings and the S&P on a sixth straight loss. Tech and bank outages and the Paraguay bank failure add to the stress. None of these is a crisis-grade, fresh shock that justifies a level above 1 or an ETF-specific veto, though the 2x S&P (SSO) position is exposed to further downside.
